artifacts.summary: Research for the three missing Decidability directory READMEs: the readme-lint gated-vs-reported contract (only Checks 1 and 3 fail the build), the code-fence-blind link scan that is the principal failure risk, the adjacent C9/C14/INV gates, the resolved house style (exemplar structure plus a Last verified stamp), and per-directory module inventories, route narratives and scope boundaries for all 33 modules.
